Title: Admins are unable to access the Exchange admin center (EAC)

User impact: Admins are unable to access the EAC. 

More info: When attempting to access the Exchange admin center, affected admins encountered an “Internal Server Error” message.
 
Final status: We've completed the rollback of the identified Exchange admin center (EAC) change. Service telemetry shows that errors have returned to expected levels, and user reports have confirmed that EAC access has been restored. Admins who continue to experience impact should close their existing EAC browser session, open a new session, and retry accessing the EAC. We’ll continue to monitor service health to ensure sustained service stability.
 
Scope of impact: Impact was specific to admins attempting to access the EAC.
 
Start time: Monday, October 12, 2026, at 8:15 AM UTC
 
End time: Monday, October 12, 2026, at 12:50 PM UTC
 
Root cause: During a routine service deployment, an update to the Exchange Admin Center authentication components introduced an incompatibility in the way delegated administrator access tokens were validated.

When administrators accessed the Exchange Admin Center through the Microsoft 365 admin experience, the updated authentication components did not successfully validate the delegated token used for the request. The service then attempted an interactive sign-in as a fallback. That fallback could not complete because the sign-in context was associated with a different service domain, resulting in an authentication failure and an Internal Server Error.

Next steps:
- For a more comprehensive list of next steps and actions, please refer to the Post Incident Report document.
 
We’ll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.

We’ve completed the rollback and are continuing to monitor service health, with telemetry showing errors trending downward from their earlier peak. Admins who continue to experience impact should close their existing Exchange admin center (EAC) browser session, open a new session, and retry accessing the EAC. We’ll continue monitoring to validate recovery.

This quick update is designed to give the latest information on this issue.

- Admins couldn't create or manage Speaker Progress resources using Speaker Progress Graph APIs

- Admins couldn't access or utilize Assignments scenarios that call Related Contacts indirectly.

Final status: We've validated through monitoring our service telemetry that access requests are succeeding once again, confirming that this issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: Admins and users who attempted to access or utilize any of the features listed in the More info section may have been impacted by this event.

End time: Saturday, September 26, 2026, at 12:20 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent roll out of an authentication configuration was causing failures when processing requests to the listed affected scenarios. 

Next steps: 
-We're investigating the impacting authentication configuration to pinpoint why it was failing to process requests as expected and why this impact wasn't caught during the testing and validation phase so that we can prevent similar impact in the future.
